prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: unit-wolf, one production battle sprite for an original dark-fantasy mercenary game, sprite-based 2.5D; final 512x512 square.
Input images: Image 1 unit-merc-sword.png and Image 2 unit-raider-axe.png are approved STYLE and WORLD SCALE references only, not subjects to copy. Translate their broad-brush black ink contours, coarse purposeful hatching, chunky dark shadow masses and muted earthy wash to an animal. Same brush weight and readable game-scale detail. No glossy 3D, photoreal fur or smooth digital painting.
Subject: one gaunt GREY forest wolf, lean ribcage and angular shoulders, lowered snarling head with visible teeth, alert ears, long coarse tail. Head, muzzle, gaze and body point LEFT. Exactly FOUR anatomically correct legs, all four paws planted on the same implied ground plane; no running, jumping, rearing, human posture or extra limbs. Dusty charcoal and stone-grey coat with subdued taupe accents, not a brown dog. Coarse fur rendered as solid opaque angular ink-and-wash tufts, never wispy translucent hairs.
Composition: complete full-body animal in a grounded threatening stance. Fixed three-quarter top-down battle camera about 50 degrees downward, clearly visible back and top of muzzle, never eye-level or flat side elevation. Match world scale to reference humans: wolf shoulder reaches about a human thigh, not human head height. Long silhouette uses about 80 percent of square width, lower half of square for the shorter animal. Paws near bottom centre, common ground anchor about x=256 y=480 on the final 512 canvas. Snout, ears, all four paws and tail fully inside frame with clear padding. No crop, scenery, rocks, platform, base or drawn hex.
Background: perfectly flat uniform solid #00ff00 chroma-key green for local alpha removal. No green anywhere in the subject. Background has no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane or lighting variation. Solid opaque silhouette with crisp ink edges; no stray ink specks, cast or contact shadow.
Constraints: original design only; do not imitate any existing game, franchise creature or artist. No text, logos, watermark, border, UI, equipment or other subjects. Deliver ONE separate square image, not a sheet or collage.
model: image_gen (built-in; underlying model identifier not exposed)
